subject: CloudAtlas vendor setup — provisional PO & spend cap / line item update
messages:
From: Sara Velez <sara@cloudatlas.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudatlas.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood onboarding paperwork + PO request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. To get CloudAtlas set up in our billing system we need the completed vendor onboarding form and a PO number for first invoice. Can you confirm: 1) the billing entity name and remit address, 2) desired spend cap for Q4 pilot, and 3) whether Redwood will accept a single consolidated line item or separate line items per model family?

If you can send the filled onboarding PDF I can generate a provisional PO this afternoon. Attaching our vendor setup checklist for reference.

Best,
Sara Velez
Head of Finance Ops
CloudAtlas Inc.
attachments: vendor_setup_checklist.pdf

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Sara Velez <sara@cloudatlas.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, michael_grant@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding paperwork + PO request

Hi Sara — attaching the completed vendor onboarding form and Redwood's remit table.

Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Remit address: 1101 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94103

For the Q4 pilot we want a conservative spend cap: $25,000 USD. Please make that visible on the provisional PO; we'll request a review mid-pilot if utilization warrants an increase.

Regarding line items: we'd prefer two line items — "Hosted API calls" and "Support & Observability (flat)" — with the API calls using usage-based unit pricing. This helps our internal chargeback tracking. If CloudAtlas' system can't accept 2 lines, fall back to consolidated.

CCing Marissa (finance) and Ben (sales ops) to make sure invoice routing and GL codes are correct.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_onboarding_form_naomi_signed.pdf

From: Sara Velez <sara@cloudatlas.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudatlas.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding paperwork + PO request

Naomi — thanks for the quick turnaround. I generated a provisional PO: PO# 89214 (see attached). We populated the spend cap at $25,000 and included the two requested line items. Notes:

- PO is provisional until we receive a signed W-9 and bank details for vendor validation.
- Our system shows a maximum single-invoice amount of $20,000 unless we add an exception; if Redwood expects single invoices to exceed that we can raise the limit but will need procurement approval.
- I added a small description on line 1 to indicate "usage-based API calls — unit pricing as per SOW" to aid accounts payable.

I can route the PO to your AP inbox and mirror to Marissa for GL code confirmation. Are you able to provide a signed W-9 by end of day Monday?

Sara
attachments: provisional_PO_89214.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sara Velez <sara@cloudatlas.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, michael_grant@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding paperwork + PO request

Sara — appreciate the fast action and the provisional PO. A couple quick clarifications from Redwood finance: 1) GL code for Hosted API calls should be 6102-MLINF (Marissa to confirm in our AP system), 2) please change the invoice remit-to email to ap-invoices@redwood.com, and 3) we will provide the signed W-9 first thing Monday.

About the single-invoice threshold: for the pilot we expect invoices to stay under $20k most months, but if CloudAtlas needs to enforce the single-invoice cap please go ahead and set the system limit to $20,000; we'll request a higher threshold if/when usage exceeds that.

Finally — small line item correction: on the provisional PO the second line reads "Support & Observability (flat)" but should be "Support & Observability (monthly)". Would you update the description before finalizing?

If you can route the provisional PO to ap-invoices@redwood.com and mark it as "provisional — awaiting W-9", we can close this out early next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: none
